verdict.rationale: A community plugin catalog is a fair question for a note-taking app, but the evidence shows no plugin or extension marketplace for Reflect. What it does ship are first-party integrations, browser clipping extensions, Zapier, deep links and an API, which are adjacent features rather than a browsable catalog of community plugins. Community comments even praise Reflect for working out of the box without plugins, in contrast to Obsidian.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse and install from a large catalog of community plugins/extensions to add features the core app doesn't ship
